state.product_goals: Compact unambiguous Can, economical AI-generated CRUD SaaS, source-owned reusable helpers, one canonical query primitive; preserve complete workflows, permissions, evaluation order, atomicity, original failure and recovery. This choice concerns private native implementation, not new Can syntax.
state.source: Imported can_work(person:user,location:Location):bool = any(Employee as e,e.user==person and e.active and active_member(person,team) and (e.operator_wide or e.home==location or location in e.locations)). Original mutation callers use require can_work(actor,input.location) and, after a first query and nonnull proof, require can_work(actor,existing.deal.location). Arguments must evaluate exactly once at original call location; no hoisting or reconstruction from call.inputs.
state.verified_existing: State executeScenarioReceiptAny already builds full viewer-authorized final-owner domain then executes predicate lazily in query order, stopping at first true, with active candidate slots, exact field read markers, membership captures and commit-time source/grant/domain checks. Its current stored-bool profile independently compares verdict to one exact stored bool. Arbitrary helper verdict includes Identity membership and cannot be reconstructed from stored row fields alone. A predicate profile needs original source-executable authentication, not an opt-in metadata flag or typeof check. Current CF Frame/NativeQueryExecution owns candidate wrapper and actual HandlerContext. Existing private membership producer synchronously consumes once-only captures tied to actual admitted call. Existing verified module getter authenticates original page predicate function identity; mutation helper/query source correspondence still must be implemented, equally for both alternatives. It cannot reuse private page/read-policy authority for a mutation guard.
state.shared_requirements: Both alternatives bind producer only after exact checked source/schema/query/call-chain validation. At original helper query point, verify original named factory, bind already-evaluated lexical helper parameters and retain closure in existing native query execution/frame. Both require per-invocation activation/capture; neither can derive lexical values from AdmittedCall alone. State supplies genuine projected candidate, active slot and native marker/membership context. Reject forged/copied/wrong-call/stale/closed/replayed occurrence; no global registry, second argument evaluation, eager dependency grants or private-field leakage. Only executed predicate dependencies demand current field grants; keep domain revalidation and original prefix/failure order. Old stored-bool path remains independently verified.
state.option_a: Installed evaluator: trusted producer evaluateAny(call,queryId,candidate):boolean|Promise<boolean> accesses that invocation's previously verified active source closure in existing native Frame. New predicate-profile State execute input contains queryId; State chooses installed evaluator. Requires same per-call source activation/capture as B and an installed lookup/dispatch of active closure. Makes executable selection State-owned; does not remove closure provenance/capture requirements.
state.option_b: Captured callback: trusted producer captureAnyPredicate(call,queryId):Predicate synchronously returns and consumes that invocation's already-verified exact native wrapper pointer. Existing State execute input {queryId,predicate} must match captured pointer, then State invokes it under genuine active slot. Requires same per-call source activation/capture as A. Preserves existing execute shape and makes capture explicit; must enforce pointer match, once-only lifetime and exact occurrence. No raw caller callback is trusted merely for being callable.
state.scope_and_uncertainty: Neither implemented yet. Existing closure/candidate/membership primitives are verified; exact imported helper executable-source/call-chain producer is still missing and required for either. Evaluate alternatives on same observable guarantees, compositional helper semantics, author token cost (equal), total implementation/maintenance and capability clarity. Smaller patch or machinery reuse alone is not decisive. Recommend further investigation if neither is sufficient; probabilities are advice, not authority.

binding.instructions: Which private binding is preferable for executing this original lazy mutation helper ANY predicate, given the verified shared capture/provenance requirements? Compare equal semantic and authority outcomes and total maintenance; select investigate if a demonstrated gap prevents either.

criteria.installed_evaluator: Prefer A: State invokes the installed producer evaluator with genuine call/query/candidate; producer looks up its verified active source closure.
criteria.captured_callback: Prefer B: State matches callback to trusted producer's synchronously consumed exact active pointer and invokes it with genuine candidate.
criteria.investigate: Neither is sufficiently justified yet; a concrete unresolved authority/semantic gap requires investigation.
